title: Phonics (Super Starter + Wonder World + Games)
description: A phonics activity for grades 1–6. Follow these simple steps to use it with your class.
steps: Log in with an active Premium account.
Choose a Super Starter, Wonder World, or phonics preset.
Choose the presentation or game activity.
Show the words and pictures to students.
Follow the game controls for the selected activity.
Export your edited sets to save a backup.
